marking_points.text: wavelength: • wavelength = distance between successive / adjacent in phase points / wavefronts / crests / troughs • λ = d / (number of) oscillations frequency: • frequency = (number of) oscillations / cycles crests / troughs / wavefronts (passing a point) per unit time • f = (number of) oscillations / t One correct point from either list

One correct point from both lists and speed = distance / time and one of: • wavelength × frequency (= distance per unit time) = speed • [(number of) oscillations / t] × [d / (number of) oscillations] = fλ • v (= d / t) = λ / (1/f) = fλ or v (= d / t) = λ / T = fλ
